main_topics.reason: The user opened by asking why they remain exhausted despite treatment and returned to the impact and persistence of the fatigue.
The user asked what a TSH of 3.8 means and whether Free T3 and Free T4 could give a fuller picture, then included those tests in their appointment plan.
The user asked whether fatigue could have other causes and discussed ferritin, B12, vitamin D, and celiac screening over several turns.
The user considered a levothyroxine dose adjustment and asked whether adding T3 or switching to desiccated thyroid was worth pursuing.
The user asked for a list of questions to bring to the doctor and later restated the plan they intended to discuss.
The user worried about being written off for raising online treatment ideas and said they had felt gaslit about their fatigue.
The user agreed a log could help because they forget how they felt week to week and may underreport symptoms.
The user said knowing a dose change may take six weeks would prevent them from panicking if they felt no difference at week two.

output.summary: The user with Hashimoto's asked why persistent exhaustion continued on levothyroxine despite a TSH they were told was normal, and explored thyroid and other possible fatigue-related tests and treatment options. The assistant helped assemble questions for the doctor and a tracking plan; the user said they felt prepared and were looking forward to the appointment.
